title: "fatal error: my_pkg/msg/my_msg.hpp: No such file or directory" with ROS 2 custom messages: snake_case headers, rosidl_get_typesupport_target and Lyrical's removed rosidl_target_interfaces, measured
excerpt: Why a C++ node can't find its custom message header: CamelCase includes (IMUData.msg generates imu_data.hpp) and same-package nodes never linked to the generated code. Fixes and the CMake errors around them, built on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
